notifications.title: CLEAVE v3.3.1.0 is available
notifications.message: CLEAVE now speaks Thai, and can write its own reconcile config. Switch the interface to Thai in Settings — no restart, and your files and output are untouched. Cleaver, a new AI assistant, turns your column headers into a ready-to-import reconcile profile without your data ever leaving the machine. And a new Auto detect button reads a file and works out which row is the header, including the awkward shapes: multi-row spec headers, AS-IS/TO-BE pairs, pivots with a Grand Total, and signature blocks. Includes everything from 3.3.0.0. Update for the latest.

notifications.title: What's new in CLEAVE v3.3.1.0
notifications.message: Three things. The interface is now available in Thai — switchable in Settings with no restart, with the Thai typeface bundled so it works offline; tool names, CLEAVE's own vocabulary and the sheet names in a produced workbook stay English so your output is unchanged. Cleaver is a new AI assistant that reads your column headers and writes the reconcile profile: open it from Home, or hand it the files already on screen from Reconcile. And Auto detect finds a sheet's header row in one click, naming the file it read and how sure it is — a reading it cannot support says so rather than guessing. Reconcile also gains duplicate-a-unit, selective config copy and undo/redo; multi-sheet Split shows a proper file/sheet hierarchy; long file lists reorder instantly again; and a batch of fixes lands across Auto detect, the AI hand-off, and the Thai interface.
